versions.changelog: SDK API rename: getOpenId→getAddress, dependency update
fix: remove deprecated whoami CLI command
refactor: rename whoami to openid (deprecated alias kept), bump SDK to v0.7.0

feat: unified --help protocol with --format json|pretty. feat: industry templates command (restaurant/insurance/checkup/tech-service/custom). feat: listen command for auto-responding to --help requests. feat: enhanced search with --limit flag and reputation scores. feat: enhanced publish with --template/--helpcmd/--summary flags and input validation. fix: CliError for proper resource cleanup on errors. fix: listen race condition fixes (process.once, pendingSends counter).
